answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the juniper deposit is held in the tide escrow, the thread audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 14 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
